```plato

    // The Jacobi (diagonal) preconditioner: the reciprocal of each diagonal
    // entry, and 1 wherever the diagonal is zero. A zero diagonal is not a
    // defect here — it is exactly what a constrained degree of freedom looks
    // like once the projection below has removed it from the system, and leaving
    // its multiplier at 1 keeps it harmless.
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Preconditioner#Jacobi_(or_diagonal)_preconditioner)
    JacobiInverseDiagonal(m: SparseMatrix): Array<Number>
    {
        var diagonal = FilledNumbers(m.NumRows, 0.0);
        var k = 0;
        while (k < m.Entries.Count)
        {
            var e = m.Entries[k];
            if (e.IsDiagonal) { diagonal = e.Row.AddAt(diagonal, e.Value); }
            k = k + 1;
        }
        return diagonal.Freeze().Map(x => x == 0.0 ? 1.0 : 1.0 / x);
    }
```
